trigger.what: Keeper flagged 12 consumable SKUs whose repurchase window closes with no lifecycle touch inside it.
Segment Value Model put the untouched cohort at 4,180 profiles and a 42-day median repurchase cycle.
Promoter sized the missing flow at $6.1K a month incremental and pinned it to the queue for a decision.

policy.label: Unsubscribe rate
policy.gap: headroom for one more weekly touch

constraints.label: Channel-level marketing consent
constraints.detail: Email and SMS consent are tracked separately. Neither is inferred from a purchase.

constraints.label: Express opt-in for SMS
constraints.detail: No SMS journey can enrol a profile without a recorded express opt-in and its timestamp.

constraints.label: Unsubscribe honoured in 4 hours
constraints.detail: Propagates across every brand and channel in the workspace. No journey can re-enrol a profile after it.

constraints.label: No re-permission campaigns
constraints.detail: Unsubscribed and suppressed profiles are out of reach for every flow, including win-back.
